items.t: Lam Research Sinks 16%, Applied Materials 15% in a Week. Lam Responds With $25 Billion Buyback
items.sum: Key TakeawaysLam Research (LRCX) fell approximately 16% during the week ended November 6, while Applied Materials (AMAT) declined roughly 15% as concerns about semiconductor spending pressured equipment stocks. Lam announced a $25 billion share repurchase authorization following the November 5 selloff, equivalent to approximately 10% of its market capitalization at the time.
